justification: Three brief fixes: (1) the Data sources card now renders from the section cards already on the client (DataSourcesCard, gated on state==='complete' + sections), so it appears even when the stream's final 'complete' event is dropped — the actual reason it was missing; (2) it carries a plain-English confidence legend defining Authoritative/Estimated/Derived/Extracted; (3) the Granny Flat card + section label renamed to 'Secondary Dwelling' with a short 'granny-flat feasibility' subtitle.

pre_impl.existing_data: collectSources(sectionEvents) builds the provenance from the streamed section cards and does NOT need the complete event. The Data sources block was previously inside CompleteSummary, which only renders when completeEvent exists; the stream's final complete event is frequently dropped (the page sets state='complete' on stream-end regardless), so CompleteSummary — and the data sources — never showed.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The data sources were gated on the complete event; they only need the section cards, which are always present once the brief finishes.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data. Extracted the existing data-sources block into a standalone DataSourcesCard, added a confidence legend, and render it independent of completeEvent. CompleteSummary keeps the confidence summary/gaps (when the complete event arrives). GF card + label renamed.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Pure display. DataSourcesCard returns null when there are no sources/links.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). CompleteSummary's provenance prop removed; tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: no Data sources card and no confidence definitions (the whole CompleteSummary was gated on a dropped event); 'Granny Flat Detection' title. After: the Data sources card + confidence legend always show on completion; the card reads 'Secondary Dwelling'.

functions.name: DataSourcesCard
functions.input: the provenance object (sources + links) aggregated from the section cards
functions.output: a card listing the data sources, source links, and a plain-English confidence legend
functions.if_none: returns null when there are no sources and no links

values: N/A - no regulatory values; provenance and confidence definitions are display copy.
queries: N/A - no database or API query; sources aggregated from data already on the client.

break_it.scenario: The stream's complete event is dropped (the common case here)
break_it.what_happens: previously the entire CompleteSummary including data sources never rendered
break_it.repro: DataSourcesCard is gated on state==='complete' && sectionEvents.length, not on completeEvent
break_it.how: the card builds from the section cards that are always present once the brief finishes

break_it.repro: the data-sources block was removed from CompleteSummary; only DataSourcesCard renders it
break_it.how: single source of truth for the data-sources block

break_it.what_happens: an empty data-sources card could show
break_it.repro: DataSourcesCard returns null with no sources/links and the render is gated on sectionEvents.length > 0
break_it.how: double-guarded: gate + the component's own null return

post_merge.other_repo: N/A. Note: the dropped 'complete' SSE event (which hides the numeric Confidence Summary) is a deeper Trigger.dev realtime streaming issue, tracked separately; this PR makes the data sources + confidence legend resilient to it.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief: the Data sources card appears at the bottom with the source list + confidence legend even though the Confidence Summary (which needs the complete event) may be absent; the Granny Flat card reads 'Secondary Dwelling'.
